instruction: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for nearby medical centres and save the address and phone number of the closest clinic in a text document named medical_centre_contact.txt on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for nearby medical centres.
Identify the closest medical centre or clinic from the search results.
Find the clinic's address and phone number.
Type the clinic name, address, and phone number into the document.
Save the file as medical_centre_contact.txt on the Desktop.
Leave the saved text file on the Desktop.
